notes.title: Alpha 0.0.0.7f0.3 patch
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]What's have in this patch;[/b][/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] - The loot rates increased for guns, backpacks, and ammo,
[*] - You can see the player name on his head,
[*] - The bug about getting an item from ground fixed,
[*] - Zombie AI is improved,
[*] - Zombie amount increased,
[*] - Some bugs about killing bandits fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about marketplace on US server fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about selling an item in the marketplace fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about changing backpack fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about footsteps fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about Crafting fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about gun shooting fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about backpack fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about bank fixed,
[*] - Some bugs about unload action fixed,
[*] - We reduced the class experience gained by having killing zombies or players with the machete from 10 to 5,
[*] - Flashlight attack consumes less stamina now,
[*] - We did reduce the delay about the next melee attack,
[*] - Baseball bat damage reduced from 25 to 15,
[*] - Flashlight damage reduced from 15 to 10,
[*] - Baton damage reduced from 25 to 15,
[*] - Machete damage reduced from 25 to 20,
[*] - Fire axe damage increased from 25 to 30,
[*] - Crowbar damage increased from 25 to 30,
[*] - Barbed Wire Baseball Bat damage reduced from 25 to 20,
[*] - We did fix a bug about Crafted MP5,
[*] - Bone stack size increased from 5 to 20,
[*] - Chips stack size increased from 5 to 10,
[*] - Loot rates reduced for these items; Water, Painkiller, Antidote, Radio, Camera.
[/list]

[h1][u][b]What's next?[/b][/u][/h1]
We are planning these features for the next update(.7f1);

- Daily login awards,
- Daily playing awards(For example; Play for 2 hours and gain the awards),
- Leaderboard,
- Weapon attachments(Weapon customization),

We are still aware that there are errors and missing and we are working hard on it. Remember that Rebirth is in the Alpha process and support us to make it even better. Thank you for your interest and patience. You can ask the errors you have encountered and what you want to ask from our Discord group or our Facebook page.

notes.title: First Big Update | Alpha 0.0.0.7 patch!
notes.content:
[b]Dear, Survivors![/b]

[b]We are with you with our first big update. Thank you very much for your support and help! This update includes improvements and many bug fixes, and we will share important topics with you under this announcement. We hope you will like this update. You can share what do you think about this update with us in Discord group or by commenting under this announcement.[/b]

[h1][b][u]What's in this patch;[/u][/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] - America server is now active!
[*] - Free Demo is available now,
[*] - Craft mechanics activated. You can find the craft machine in the safe zone. You will earn class experience points for every recycling and production you make on the craft machine.
[*] - Character class skills are partially activated,
[*] - 2 different fun modes added (details are given below),
[*] - Improvement in footstep sound physics,
[*] - Melee combat mechanics improved,
[*] - Fixed the delay issue about melee weapons attack,
[*] - Fixed the delay in firing weapons,
[*] - Fixed issue where zombies didn't react to gunshots,
[*] - Fossil ability of hunter class characters is now active. If your hunter class character has "Machete" in slot 2, you can collect "Bone" from the Zombies and Users you have killed. This gives you both Class Experience Points and can Craft bullets for the "Crafted MP5" weapon with these "Bones".
[*] - Improved loot rate and logic,
[*] - Craft mechanics and resources system are activated. You will be able to use the items you find in the world for Craft and turn them into resources. You will often need these resources to craft an item on a Craft machine.
[*] - Crosshair now reacts to user actions. For example, when you run and shoot continuously, the crosshair will grow.
[*] - Character walking and running speeds are accelerated by an extra 20%,
[*] - Character melee animation speeds increased 75%,
[*] - Rare invisible zombie issue fixed,
[*] - Fixed zombie versus bugs,
[*] - Fixed some character animation issues,
[*] - The number of melee animations has been reduced to 1 to create a player experience
[*] - Use of gun spends stamina,
[*] - Improved camera controls indoors,
[*] - We fixed the distortion of the moving characters clothes,
[*] - Attacking melee weapons now spends less Stamina,
[*] - Crafted MP5 firing speed increased,
[*] - Gold loot rate from zombies increased,
[*] - Character level up easier now,
[*] - When hunger and thirst rates are above 90%, your life is renewed,
[*] - FPS controls improved,
[*] - Fixed an error that caused your character to slow down when you tried to go in different directions while running,
[*] - Fixed a bug that caused us to miss zombies very often with melee weapons,
[*] - Chocolate now gives an additional amount of Stamina,
[*] - When you consumed Chips you are getting thirsty now,
[*] - Antidote now relieves a small amount of hunger and thirst and gives Stamina,
[*] - Fixed error in the map due to resolution,
[*] - Problems in the Bank were fixed,
[*] - Fixed issue where overall quality setting did not affect the game
[*] - Fixed issue where inventory was not updated when getting respawn from the game pause menu,
[*] - Added inspection of zombie body, finding items and resources (information about resources system can be found below),
[*] - Users belongings will no longer fall to the ground, we will inspect their bodies,
[*] - Players will now be alerted via chat automatically 1 minute before their daily server reset
[*] - You will now be able to examine the skills of the classes on the character creation screen,
[*] - Ping control is now performed when connecting to servers, and the user is warned if there is high ping,
[*] - Now the installation screen shows tips from the Tips pool,
[*] - Added an information button to the server selection screen so that you can get information about the server type (mode) before entering,
[*] - Fixed some interface issues in the marketplace,
[*] - Added an option for a performance tool named Occlusion Culling to the Options tab, you can learn the details by clicking the info icon,
[*] - We've implemented a simpler theme to improve performance on the lobby screen,
[*] - Motion Blur camera effect added to the game, settings screen has shutdown options,
[*] - Particle option now affects the game,
[/list]


[h1][b][u]About The Free Demo;[/u][/b][/h1]

The free demo is for users who are curious about the game and want to experience the game before buying it. Allows you to play the game without time limitation. The course has several restrictions. Restrictions are as follows;
[List]
[*] - You cannot use guns in the original game mode, you can only use guns in fun modes,
[*] - Even if you change your backpack, your number of slots is fixed,
[*] - You cannot make permanent progress, You cannot improve your character,
[*] - You cannot use the marketplace,
[*] - You cannot use the craft machine,
[/list]


[h1][b][u]About Fun Modes;[/u][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]PvP Fun Mode; [/b][/h1]
In this server, you will try to survive against players, with random guns and items. The first 3 players will be rewarded with XP and Gold. Much more than 5 players need to be ready to start the game.

[h1][b]Night Fun Mode; [/b][/h1]
In this server, you will try to survive against players and zombies, with random guns and items. The first 3 players will be rewarded with XP and Gold. Much more than 5 players need to be ready to start the game.

[i][u][b]Items in fun modes are used only in fun modes, they do not remain in your character.[/b][/u][/i]


[h1][b][u]About Resources System; [/u][/b][/h1]

There are only 5 resources in our resources system. These resources; Metal, Wood, Wool, Powder, Chemical. To obtain resources, you must recycle the items you find in the Rebirth universe on the Craft machine. You will then use these resources to craft an item on the Craft machine.


[h1][u][b]Possible features for 0.0.0.7f1;[/b][/u][/h1]

- Daily login award,
- Leaderboard system,
- Renewal of the original game mode map (details are given below),


[h1][u][b]Features planned to be added for the next big update;[/b][/u][/h1]

- Clan system,
- Loot zones can be captured by clans,
- Base capture system,


[b]In our original game mode, we noticed a performance issue about the map caused by Unity's terrain development tool. The only way to fix this error is to make a new map without using this tool. For this reason, our art team is working on a small map to be published in the next 1 month. With this small map, we will eliminate the performance problem in the original game mode. The map will be more graphically beautiful and more enjoyable to explore. After the update, our art team will continue to work on this map to make bigger.[/b]

[b]We are still aware that there are errors and missing and we are working hard on it. Remember that Rebirth is in the Alpha process and support us to make it even better. Thank you for your interest and patience. You can ask the errors you have encountered and what you want to ask from our Discord group or our Facebook page.[/b]

[h1][u][b]Rebirth Discord;[/b][/u][/h1]
[url=https://discord.gg/GDrhNjy]https://discord.gg/GDrhNjy[/url]

[h1][u][b]Rebirth Facebook;[/b][/u][/h1]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/InfoRebirthGame/]https://www.facebook.com/InfoRebirthGame/[/url]

notes.title: Alpha 0.0.0.6f3 patch
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Survivors!

.6f1, .6f2 and .6f3 patches only have bug fix. We will another update in a few days(.6f4) and it will be about improvement. Now as far as we can see there are no more bugs affecting gameplay, we did fix all of them in .6f1, .6f2 and .6f3 patches.[/b]

[u][b]What's have in these patches;[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] We've fixed some animation errors,
[*] We didn't get the sound effect when we used melee weapons, we fixed this,
[*] We've fixed more than 5 errors in zombie versus mechanics,
[*] We've fixed the problem of zombies non-visible from time to time,
[*] We've fixed more than 10 bugs for the interface,
[*] We've made improvements to the melee system (will re-improvement in the .6f4 update),
[*] We've fixed more than 5 bugs for the Chat screen,
[*] We've fixed some sound effect issues,
[*] We've simplified the zombie versus mechanics, we did reduce the power of the zombie,
[*] We fixed the problem of not moving the camera for a while when the game was opened,
[*] We've fixed the stacking problem in the inventory,
[*] Level up is easier now,
[*] When you level up, all of your values (Health, hunger, thirst, stamina) are now getting full. And for additional gifts, you have won (Bank slot, Condition skill point) you are informed in-game,
[*] Zombie texture files edited,
[*] We fixed the problem of not moving the zombies
[/list]

[u][b]More than 30 errors like these have been corrected. Thank you for your support and understanding.[/b][/u]

[u][b]Some information from 0.7 patch;[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] - US server is opening,

[*] - Model update about clothes rig,
[*] - Now the items won't fall down, you're going to examine the bodies of the players,

We are still aware that there are errors and missing and we are working hard on it. Remember that Rebirth is in the Alpha process and support us to make it even better. notes.title: Release date update
notes.content:
[b]Dear players![/b]

Due to server failures, the release date was postponed to [u][b]25 February[/b][/u]. This postponement has been made not to disappoint our players. We're trying to make sure you guys play a game smoothly.

notes.title: Launch date!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Rebirth will be released on Steam on February 22nd. We are delighted to share this news with you. We will give you some information about Rebirth universe and our work plans.

- First, comments about system requirements in social media and various sites. We have developed special software to improve performance optimization. In addition, we have made the world smaller than we planned, allowing players with a low computer to play the game.

- Within 1 month after the launch, we will provide weekly updates and the features we specify on the store page will be active in the game. With the launch of the game, you will be able to use the bank service in addition to the basic gameplay mechanics. Features such as character development will be accessible within the interface but will not affect the game.

- At the end of a 1-month period, we will provide a service that has not been presented in any game before. We will give our players a list of features that we will add to the game and ask them which the feature they want to add to the game first. As a result of this vote, we will start working for the selected feature.

- An error reporting screen will be found in the game. Each notification from this screen will be reviewed by our team and if the notification you made is correct, you will be rewarded with diamonds. The reward will increase according to the size of the error.

- Rebirth is not pay to win, and will not be. Diamond will be a currency that can be purchased with real money. Additional services will be available to purchase with diamond. Additional services examples; character name change, Premium, additional clan slots, additional character slots. In addition, Diamond can be converted to another currency, Gold (Exam.; 1 diamond = 10 gold). Buying diamonds will not reinforce one user against another.

- There will be a market in the game, you will sell your items in this market with Gold. You will be able to buy the items you need with the gold.

- On the screen of death, a report button will be active. In this way, if your death is caused by an error or you have been killed by a user who uses a hack, we will monitor and examine the last minutes of your death. If you are right in the examination, the items you lost when you died will be returned to you.

For more information you can send us a message via Facebook.

[u][b]See you at the hunt on February 22![/b][/u]
